acceptance: The campaign reservation suite proves a blocked reserved ticket is skipped until its reservation-local blocker is fixed, a named campaign claim is accepted only for its own partition and records campaign_id/partition_id, and campaign abort archives and removes an unclosed reservation while refusing active children or parent owners; ordinary non-campaign claims remain green.
acceptance_cmd: uv run --no-project --python 3.13 --with pytest pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider ops/tests/test_worktree_campaign_reservation.py ops/tests/test_worktree_orchestrate_delivery.py -k 'campaign or reservation or provenance'
brief: Campaign claim and abort tooling lost admission dependencies/provenance: the campaign selector could choose a blocked ticket, named campaign claims could not preserve campaign metadata, and a force-resolved empty child could strand a reservation. Manager needs one fail-closed control path before the next wave.
contract_evidence: Static preflight: exact control-plane files and bounded regression command are known; baseline is red because the regression implementation is not yet present.
detail: The live wave exposed three coupled control-plane defects: campaign next-ticket selection ignored reservation-local blocked_by edges; open could not perform a named claim from a campaign partition while preserving campaign_id/partition_id; and teardown of a clean campaign child left a live reservation with no usable closure path. Add atomic campaign claim selection/validation, a provenance-preserving named campaign claim path, and a Manager-only campaign abort lifecycle that refuses active children/parents and archives the aborted reservation. Keep ordinary dispatch and parent receipt semantics unchanged.
plan: 1. Write regression tests for reservation-local dependency ordering, named campaign claim provenance and partition refusal, and abort safety/archival. 2. Implement the smallest locked registry/orchestrator changes; preserve normal open and parent integration behavior. 3. Run focused campaign/orchestrator tests and docs/surface checks. 4. Mark the tooling ticket fixed only with exact evidence.
